Kolding is a Danish municipality assessed in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Database for Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1] [^src2]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, focusing on key indicators for anticoagulation therapy, safety monitoring, and stroke prevention [^src1] [^src2]. 

Kolding is specifically noted for its strong performance on Indicator 4b, which measures adherence to safety practices for patients treated with DOAC medications [^src1]. The municipality successfully met the required standard for this indicator, achieving a compliance rate of 95.8% (1,482 out of 1,547 eligible patients) [^src1]. This marks one of the highest compliance proportions among the evaluated municipalities [^src1]. Additionally, Kolding is tracked under other clinical indicators in the report—such as those measuring early initiation of anticoagulation and the prevention of ischemic strokes—where it also met the standard ("Ja"), recording a 1.0% metric (20 out of 2,007 patients) in one specific measurement category [^src2]. 

No further relationships, explicit claims, or timeline events are detailed in the provided corpus for this entity.
